historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 2156 Leavenworth Street.

The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works as to the standpipe and fire-resistant deck material in the denial of a permit to alter the building at 2156 Leavenworth Street on rehearing, with a condition for a railing.
